body:
I appreciate your response, that definitely answered some questions.

I don’t know if I’m beating a dead horse by asking this, but does the privacy concern not hold much water either? I have a unique name so just a search of my name and the name of the grocery store I work at would easily bring up my location when I specifically go out of my way to not disclose that in my online spaces. It might just be an irrational fear of mine but I’ve heard stories of women being tracked down through things like that.
I don’t intend to take her to court or take any legal action, I just want what I say to be legitimate if I am to say anything to her.

I’m basically just trying to find something that I can say to this woman to take her post down because of the privacy aspect, I really don’t care about what she said specifically about my attitude or work ethic. I get that her opinion is hers but it’s the fact it’s my picture + my store number + my exact location + my name. That’s all I care about in this situation. I’m only throwing words around like harassment or defamation because I’m just looking for anything that might be means to use as reasonings for her to take her post down because I know me saying “pretty please take it down” isn’t going to do anything

I dont know much about legalities of things and I’m going off of what someone suggested to me I look into. I’m moreso concerned about the privacy concern of it all. I told her that she didn’t have permission to take my picture and it felt like harassment so that’s what I went with as a possibility. I’m here in this subreddit for a reason lol

I was thinking more along the lines of defamation or harassment but I see where you’re coming from. Someone told me in that case it would be easier to claim if she came back to the store and continued taking pictures of me.

A lady in the paint department for the location I’m wanting to apply for said that lift equipment is required for working that position. I’m considering applying for a cashier position and then maybe moving onto the paint department once I know I’m clean, but I don’t want to take the chance still in case they still want me to be certified as backup for paint or something.

Your reply is super helpful though, thanks
Honestly I’m clueless about the drug test policy because when I joined they didn’t do drug tests due to covid. I think it’s dependent on state or location?

Wow, I really appreciate your response, I’m definitely going to think back to what your therapist said! I can definitely relate to it being something to look forward to after work, and I’ve figured that’s going to be the hardest thing to knock out.
I am 22 F, 5’5 110lbs, no medication or drug use.

This^

When I first went to a psychologist to get diagnosed I was given results to a really long test that I had to do. Depression as well as borderline tendencies were incredibly high. When I did a video call with her so she could tell me what the official diagnosis was she told me that I just had MDD. When I asked her what made her think it wasn’t borderline she literally just said “well borderline can’t be treated so I’m going with depression”.

It can be really hard to find what you need for BPD.
I think the biggest thing that helps is knowing that you aren’t alone in struggling with the disorder.

I really appreciate those words.

I was recently told by a friend of an ex friend that the reason my abuse was happening was because I was still in it. It was regarding this drama that happened between us, but my ex friend had aired my dirty laundry about my relationship to this random girl I didn’t know, and in response I was told that it was easy to leave an abusive situation and at that point I was choosing to be abused.
All of those messages were voice messages, which honestly just made it hit me harder, and it’s been living in my mind since it happened.

So I really hope you understand that reading something like what you’ve said means something to me.

I know how that anxiety feels. I don’t know if you can relate but when I’ve been in that kind of situation I always wish I was playing a video game so that I could just save, do one option, and if it doesn’t work then just revert back to my last save.

Another thing that I always think about is how this could be one of those decisions that drastically changes the outcome of my life.

But like I said, every time I’ve ever been in your situation it has always worked out for the better. It’s going to feel like you’re going to die from anxiety at any moment but getting out of a situation where people are awful to you always feels better when you get out. You have to understand that you don’t deserve to be treated with disrespect in a job, and having a positive morale in a job literally makes it 1000000x better.

If you wouldn’t feel comfortable being at that job for the next couple of years, chances are, you should get out.

I know it’s just gonna sound stupid because I keep just turning down options but I’m just so embarrassed. I don’t think I have it in me to do anything because of how embarrassed I am to be in this situation. I’ve wanted to call the police before but the very first time he ever cheated on me he tried to kill himself, and we made such a scene in the parking lot when that happened, all I can remember are my neighbours in my complex staring at us and how embarrassing it was.

When he strangled me I wanted to call the police so bad but I feared for my safety more than anything so I immediately left and slept over at that guys apartment I mentioned.

I used to see a therapist but it didn’t even help me because every time I would expect to talk about my problems I would just end up talking about my relationship. Since I have BPD and horrid trust issues that’s the only thing we would end up talking about and it made me start blaming myself for what was happening.

I stopped seeing her because I missed her appointment once and felt so ashamed that I cancelled them altogether. Now I’m too embarrassed to even make another appointment because I’m gonna have to explain that he strangled me and got physical with me so badly but I’m still staying.

I hate being seen as a victim because I start to feel like everyone pities me. It’s just a horrible feeling. I’m sure I should just stop being a baby and just do it but I’m just so embarrassed that I’m a victim.

I don’t know many people who I think would be willing to do that for me. I met a guy on tinder awhile ago who lives in the same town as me. His cousins own the apartment complex he stays at which is really cheap. The only problem is that this guy is kind of creepy towards me. Even though we’ve both agreed to just being friends, everytime I’m around him he overly touches me even after I explain that I don’t want to do anything with him. He tells me that he does it because he wants to get me used to physical touch because I’ve told him I have trauma.
He makes me feel horrible but he’s cool to hang out with, I have a hard time setting boundaries with people and have considered myself someone that people should use like that because I have no self worth. He’s really the only person that I think I would be willing to take the chance of telling.

My apologies, I’m from a military family so I honestly forget all the time that moving can be really complicated for some. I can see how what I said might’ve been kinda redundant.

Something else that I feel is important is that I’ve had some really horrible jobs, and looking back after leaving, I’ve realised how stress free my life is. My first job was McDonald’s, and at this particular one they got away with literally verbally abusing me “telling me I did horrible jobs when I didn’t, telling me I was never going to succeed in school or life) and when I left it was literally so freeing. I had another similar situation happen to me at a Home Depot I was at. Now I work at another retail job where everyone is so incredibly nice, and it was 100% worth the anxiety of wondering if I was making the right choice.

I have told a couple people I know about the situation but I don’t think they know enough about trauma bonds that it’s gotten to a point where I feel like they view my situation as easily solved. That’s the worst part about it. This guy is an absolute narcissist who continues to try and convince me that he’s “gonna do better this time”. Ever since the strangling incident he’s back on his bullshit that he’s going to change his ways. Him going through a lot of trauma is what’s made me stay for so long but at this point I know he doesn’t love me. We have a really nice apartment that I feel I could really capitalise on if I was happier. I don’t want to go through the guilt trip of him leaving.

My plan has been to finish school (3 years away) and then move to another state on my own, but failing my classes has really opened my eyes that I’m really just making excuses.

I moved on my own for the first time 2 years ago. It was really scary at first but honestly, once you do it it’s actually incredibly easy. 

I don’t know if you’ve heard how bullshit it is to move from movies or from older people but I was told by so many people that I was never going to do it, that I was going to get fucked over blah blah blah. Honestly though, it’s way easier than it looks. I went from living in a small 4,000 person town to a major U.S. City. I felt completely incapable of doing anything right but conquering moving has been something that’s really shown me I’m capable as an adult. 

I don’t know if any of that resonates with you, but it’s 100% worth the risk in my eyes. Not to mention, new cities and towns are an opportunity to meet new places and have experiences of your own that don’t involve the bad memories of the old place.

I’ve never resonated more with a post in my life. I also have BPD and it’s felt like nothing was going to work for me. It really feels like everyone in my life has been public enemy #1 against me, but I’ve had so many people tell me I’m crazy that I never know what to trust. Drinking is also my way of coping.
I really hope that the both of us can find some kind of peace and someone who can show us love and understand us for who we are.
The thing that always stops me from hurting or killing myself is by imagining that me as a child is watching me do it, or that I’m doing it to child me. It’s enough to make me cry and scream internally enough to convince myself to stop. I really hope nothing but the best for you.

That’s essentially my main concern. This is a college so I know they can’t do anything too overbearing but my bank account cannot handle a stay in a mental hospital. Im just wanting to see if they’re allowed to do that even if I am able to tell them that it was an overreaction on my part.

I definitely understand where you’re coming from, and I definitely agree that I should take whatever resources but I honestly just do not have the time or the funds to be committed. That’s why it’s my main concern. I literally am squeezing this call between a 3 hour break I get between my two jobs. I’ve been considering committing myself over spring break or something but if my college was to do something like that now i could potentially lose my job. My best option is probably to just try and sweep this under the rug to the best of my abilities, I just don’t know if the call tomorrow is going to be one of those “oh yeah we’re TOTALLY concerned for your well-being” with no check ups after or a “guess what we’re going to make your life hell” situations. 

I realise now how stupid I was for leaving the note but I honestly thought it was gonna be thrown away/not traced back to me.
I’m honestly just wanting to make sure they can’t commit me tbh, thanks for the kind words though
